verdict.rationale: Bland's docs explicitly document creating/managing inbound phone numbers, outbound call dispatch via API, bringing your own Twilio numbers, and SIP for both inbound/outbound, all programmatically accessible, plus a CLI/MCP that manage phone numbers and calls end-to-end. Missing for 10: no explicit REST API reference/OpenAPI spec confirmed (probe shows openapi.json 404s) and no independent hands-on developer report of a full provision+call round trip.
